AstropesGift.desc: Perform a lightning enhanced attack dealing physical damage and lightning damage.

CausticSpearhead.desc: Perform a burst attack dealing increased damage, additional poison damage and inflicting Poisoned on hit.

DeathFromAbove.desc: Call down a rain of falling spears on target location dealing poison damage and slowing monsters struck.

Envenom.desc: On monster kill you have a chance to explode toxic fissures on all monsters around thje target dealing poison damage and inflicting Poisoned.

LeapingAmbush.desc: Jump towards target location dealing poison damage and knocking up monsters around you upon landing.

NoxiousStrike.desc: Unleash a poisonous strike dealing physical damage and  poison damage. Every third strike sends out piercing poisonous projectiles dealing damage and inflicting Poisoned on hit.

Rebound.desc: Perform an attack dealing physical damage and  lightning damage that rebounds to the closest monster.

Spearnage.desc: Furiously throw lightning enchanted spears towards target location.

StormDash.desc: Dash towards target location striking nearby monsters with chain lightning.

ThunderFury.desc: Perform an attack dealing physical damage that spreads lightning behind the target.

CrowdDiver.desc: Charge towards target location knocking monsters up on hit dealing physical damage.

HeadBanger.desc: Every third attack unleashes a headbang dealing area of effect damage.

MoshpitMassacre.desc: Summon a death metal crowd to fight monsters within the area radius draining a portion of your maximum mana over time dealing physical damage.

ProgeniesOfTheGreatCataclysm.desc: Summon a massive amplifier playing black metal at high volume sending piercing notes towards nearby monsters bouncing from terrain dealing lightning damage. If you are too far from the amplifier it is pulled back to your position.

PyroTechnician.desc: Blink into the closest monster to target location unleashing an area of effect attack dealing physical and fire damage.

SacrilegiousSymphony.desc: Channel for a brief moment before unleashing a massive area of effect pulse around you dealing lightning damage.

SlayingRiffs.desc: Drop an amplifier from the sky smashing the ground and send notes towards enemies dealing lightning damage. Dropping an amplifier on another one causes the first one to explode.

VisceralGrowl.desc: Unleash a visceral growl in a frontal cone dealing lightning damage.

Blender.desc: Swing two huge butchers knives around you dealing physical damage.

BrutalizingSlash.desc: Attack with brutalizing area of effect attack causing monsters to bleed.

ButchersHook.desc: Flail a huge meat hook around you gathering all monsters struck then pulling and stunning them infront of you.

ChainRip.desc: Perform a powerful attack pulling all nearby monsters infront of you.
subtalents: They Never Know What Hit Them

ChainSwing.desc: Throw a meat hook that pulls you into it when connecting with monster or environment. Additionally fires chains to nearby monsters when landing.

FuriousStrike.desc: Perform a powerful area of effect attack dealing physical damage and infecting monsters struck with a stack of rabies. Each stack of rabies increases attack damage dealt to the monster.

SlicingThrow.desc: Throw your weapon like a boomerang returning back to you dealing physical damage to monsters on its path. You can activate Daisy's Call to re-appear where the last thrown slicing throw is at any point in the flight.

SubmergedKnives.desc: Smash the ground pushing waves of butchers knives out of the ground dealing massive damage and knocking them up. Deals extra damage to bleeding targets.

AbsoluteMayhem.desc: Harness the power of your inner demon and fire multiple massive bullets in a line dealing physical damage.

BulletHell.desc: Fire a barrage of bullets towards the aimed direction dealing physical damage.

DemonsCalling.desc: Become airborne and smash the ground dealing area of effect arcane damage and stunning monsters around you.

FastSlices.desc: Perform a series of dashing attacks, dealing area of effect physical damage on second attack and stunning monsters around you on the final attack.

PossessedBullet.desc: Fire a satanic bullet possessed by darkness which explodes into multiple bullets on impact dealing physical damage.

ShredderTrap.desc: Throw a shredder on the ground spinning with deadly speed dealing physical damage.

SliceOfShadows.desc: Perform an attack that releases a wave of shadow dealing physical damage.

TriggerFinger.desc: Fire a burst shot dealing physical damage.

Asteroid.desc: Cast down an asteroid from the sky dealing cold damage when landing.

BlackHole.desc: Cast a black hole on target location that slows and pulls monsters towards it dealing cold damage.

LunarOrbit.desc: Unleash small moons in your orbit dealing cold damage on hit.

ScorchingWhip.desc: Cast a scorching solar flare that whips forward dealing fire damage to monsters hit.

SolarDash.desc: Turn into a burning ball of fire traveling towards target location dealing fire damage leaving a trail of flames behind you.

SolarFlare.desc: Unleash solar flare projectiles that homes towards monsters.

SuperNova.desc: Explode into a supernova dealing fire damage on a large radius.

Tsunami.desc: Direct your lunar mass to cast a wave of tsunami forward dealing cold damage.

AgeProliferation.desc: Channel waves of fractal energy on the target monster sending pulses out dealing arcane damage to nearby monsters.

CircleOfGuardians.desc: Conjure a circle of Sand Guardians around you increasing Sand Guardians’ arcane damage.

GravitationalSlam.desc: Raise monsters in target location into the air smashing them down with quantum force dealing arcane damage.

SandGuardian.desc: Conjure a Sand Guardian that attacks nearby monsters dealing arcane damage.

TemporalHeroes.desc: Summon a fractal Viking, Pyromancer and Marksman to fight on your side.

Avalanche.desc: Release a bellowing shout dealing cold damage to all monsters around you and freezing them.

Blizzard.desc: Cast a freezing blizzard dealing area of effect cold damage and freezing monsters in the target area.

BreathOfIce.desc: Breathe glacial air freezing and dealing cold damage to monsters.

FlashFreeze.desc: Perform an attack enhanced with ice that unleashes a chaining orb of ice, exploding into icicles at the end dealing additional cold damage.

FreezingLeap.desc: Leap through the air into target location freezing and dealing cold damage to monsters when landing.

FrozenBoulder.desc: Throw a frozen boulder dealing cold damage to monsters on its path.

OrbOfFrost.desc: Cast a frozen orb traveling in target direction releasing icicles, freezing and dealing cold damage to monsters on its path.

PortalOfIce.desc: Teleport to the target location and release a frost nova dealing cold damage.

Annihilation.desc: Violently rip all serrated chains out of monsters dealing area of effect damage. Targets affected by retiarius net take increased damage.

Bombardment.desc: Rapidly throw a barrage of small bombs in target direction dealing area of effect fire damage.

BouncingGrenade.desc: Throw a grenade that bounces exploding into shrapnel on impact, dealing area of effect fire damage.

ChainTrap.desc: Throw a chain trap into the target location dealing arcane damage and hooking nearby monsters with chains.

CrazyGrapple.desc: Throw a massive spike ball into target location dealing area of effect fire damage and dragging yourself towards it through the air.

HeavyBall.desc: Flail a big chained spike ball dealing physical damage to monsters on its path.

MadnessControl.desc: Hook nearby monsters towards you stunning them and dealing arcane damage. Additionally summon a bomb from the sky onto your location creating an explosion that deals arcane damage.

RetiariusNet.desc: Throw a retiarius net dealing area of effect arcane damage and stunning monsters hit.

SerratedChains.desc: Perform an area of effect attack with increased attack rating and damage attaching serrated chains to monsters.

TheBigBoom.desc: Throw a huge bo-omb scattering into shrapnel on impact dealing area of effect fire damage.

ArrowRain.desc: Unleash a rain of arrows from the sky dealing increased damage.

ArrowRampage.desc: Unleash a swarm of arrows towards the direction aimed dealing arcane and physical damage.

ArrowTurret.desc: Build an arrow turret that shoots arrows at the closest monster dealing arcane damage.

CannonTurret.desc: Build a cannon turret that launches cannonballs towards the nearest monster that explode into shrapnel, dealing area of effect arcane damage.

FragGrenade.desc: Throw a frag grenade dealing area of effect arcane damage launching shrapnel around.

Landmine.desc: Lay down a landmine at the target location exploding shortly after detecting a nearby monster dealing arcane damage.

Multishot.desc: Fire multiple arrows in an arc dealing increased damage.

RocketTurret.desc: Build a rocket turret that shoots rockets towards the nearest monster dealing area of effect arcane damage.

Trickshot.desc: Shoot an arrow with increased attack rating that bounces from monster to monster dealing increased attack damage.

Vault.desc: Vault in the direction aimed unleashing arrows towards nearby monsters dealing increased damage.

VolatileShot.desc: Fire a colossal arrow exploding on hit dealing area of effect damage.

BoneShred.desc: Unleash bone fragments dealing arcane damage to monsters.

BoneSpear.desc: Launch a piercing bone spear dealing arcane damage.

BoneSpirit.desc: Spawn a bone spirit that seeks out the nearest monster and explodes on impact, causing an Arcane damage explosion, then seeks out other mobs after the first impact.

CorpseExplosion.desc: Cause all corpses in target area to explode and deal an explosive arcane damage.

MeatBomb.desc: Throw a huge lump of meat that explodes on impact dealing arcane damage and leaving corpse on the ground.

PoisonBreath.desc: Unleash a rotten breath of toxins dealing poison damage.

PoisonNova.desc: Unleash a toxic poison nova dealing poison damage and inflicting Poisoned on all monsters hit.

RaiseSkeletonMage.desc: Raise a skeleton mage from target corpse to fight on your side.

SummonDamnedLegion.desc: Summon a damned legion to fight on your side.

BladeStrike.desc: Perform a cleave attack with increased chance for critical strike and critical strike damage.

ChainSlice.desc: Perform an enhanced attack that causes a sharp blade to chain between nearby monsters dealing damage.

CloudOfSand.desc: Unleash a cloud of sand that travels forwards dealing arcane damage, by casting the skill again Nomad will re-locate on the sand clouds position dealing area of effect arcane damage and stunning nearby monsters.

EyeOfRa.desc: Perform a light enchanted attack bringing rays of sun down to nearby monsters dealing increased damage.

FlyingScimitar.desc: Throw a huge piercing scimitar dealing increased damage to monsters in its path which returns back to you after a short delay.

PhantomBlade.desc: Spawn a ghostly blade that attacks nearby monsters dealing physiical damage and additional arcane damage.

SandCarver.desc: Perform an attack that flings piercing sand at monsters.

SandGush.desc: Unleash a gush of sand that spawns tornadoes dealing arcane damage.

SandTremors.desc: Strike a target causing sand tremors to hit nearby monsters dealing increased damage.

SandVortex.desc: Summon a massive vortex of quick sand that pulls monsters inside dealing arcane damage.

ScimitarCharge.desc: Charge a short distance unleashing scimitar strike around you dealing increased damage to monsters struck.

BallLightning.desc: Turn into a ball of lightning and dash towards to the target location, dealing lightning damage to nearby monsters upon landing.

DivineStorm.desc: Turn your attack into a divine storm dealing area of effect lightning damage around you.

FistOfTheHeavens.desc: Call down a fist of divine energy exploding into multiple Holy Bolts dealing arcane damage.

HolyBolt.desc: Cast a piercing bolt of holy light dealing arcane damage to monsters hit.

HolyHammer.desc: Summon a holy hammer that spirals outwards dealing arcane damage on hit.

HolyNova.desc: Cast a nova of holy light dealing arcane damage to monsters and healing all allies hit.

HolyShockAura.desc: When active shock monsters around you dealing lightning damage.

LightningFury.desc: Strike monsters with increased attack damage causing lightning to chain between them dealing lightning damage.

Vengeance.desc: Strike monsters with a lightning shock that splits towards nearby monsters, dealing physical damage and lightning damage.

AnchorSwing.desc: Unleash a massive anchor swinging around you dealing cold damage.

BombBarrage.desc: Start rapidly firing cannonballs dealing area of effect fire damage.

Buckshot.desc: Quick draw your musket and release a ranged buckshot with increased damage and additional fire damage.
subtalents: One Slug to End Them All

Cannonball.desc: Shoot a cannonball that launches in the air on hit and deals area of effect damage when landing.

ExplosiveBarrel.desc: Spawn a barrel of explosives which detonates after some time or when shot with a projectile dealing fire damage.

LandAhoy.desc: Call for the main ship to bombard the targeted area dealing area of effect cold damage.

Parrot.desc: Summon a parrot to peck your monsters dealing cold damage.

PowderTrail.desc: Throw a keg of gunpowder causing a chain of explosions dealing fire damage.

Torrent.desc: Summon a pool of corrupted water on target location bursting into a massive torrent that knocks up monsters struck dealing cold damage.

Crematus.desc: Unleash a breath of toxic flames dealing poison damage.

JarOfLeeches.desc: Throw a glass jar towards target location releasing leeches dealing poison damage on impact.

Miasma.desc: Empower your attack with a mixture of chemicals causing the monster to release a toxic cloud dealing physical damage.

PlagueMaster.desc: Cause all poisoned targets on target location to spread the plague and deal poison damage to monsters around them.

PlagueOfRats.desc: Send plague rats in target direction dealing poison damage on impact.

RandyTheRancidRat.desc: Summon randy the rancid rat to fight for you dealing poison damage.

SurgicalBloodLetting.desc: Throw a surgical knife with razor sharp accuracy that bounces from monster to monster dealing physical damage.

ToxicFlask.desc: Throw a bouncing toxic flask towards target location dealing poison damage.

CarrionWorm.desc: Summons a carrion worm frequently attacking nearby monsters.

EntColossus.desc: Summons an ent colossus to fight by your side.

LeapingCharge.desc: Perform a charging leap forward inflicting physical damage to monsters on hit.

MaelstromOfFrost.desc: Summon a maelstrom of frost around you inflicting cold and physical damage on hit.

Raven.desc: Summon a raven circling around you attacking nearby monsters.

SpiritOfEnt.desc: Morph into an Ent with a chance to knock monsters back on hit stunning and dealing additional damage when colliding with terrain.

SpiritOfForest.desc: Summons a spirit of the forest increasing life and mana for you and your party. Only one spirit can be summoned.

SummonEnt.desc: Summons an ent to fight by your side.

ThornedBranch.desc: Throw a thorned branch dealing poison damage on hit.

ThornedRoots.desc: Unleash a swarm of roots dealing poison damage on hit.

WoundingPaw.desc: Strike monsters with increased damage with a chance to unleash a ripple of blood.

Armageddon.desc: Call down a rain of meteors from the sky dealing area of effect fire damage to monsters struck.

BlazingTrail.desc: Leave behind a trail of fire dealing fire damage to monsters.

BreathOfFire.desc: Breathe burning flames dealing fire damage and inflicting burning on hit.

Comet.desc: Call down a huge comet exploding on impact dealing area of effect fire damage.

FireNova.desc: Cast a nova of fire around you dealing fire damage.

Fireball.desc: Cast a fireball dealing fire damage to monsters.

Hydra.desc: Spawn a fiery hydra that shoots fireballs with area of effect fire damage towards the closest monster.

InfernoSlash.desc: Send forward a fire enchanted cleave attack dealing increased damage and additional fire damage.

PhoenixFlight.desc: Charge forward through the air dealing area of effect fire damage when landing.

ScorchingAura.desc: Scorch monsters around you dealing fire damage.

Volcano.desc: Spawn a molten volcano that deals fire damage around it and spews out burning rocks that explode on hit.

ChainsawMassacre.desc: Violently spin your chainsaw dealing damage to monsters around you. Going the full distance unleashes a whirl attack with increased damage and area of effect.

MoonshineMolotov.desc: Throw a bottle of moonshine that ignites the impacted area on fire and sends out burning oil.

PickupRaid.desc: Call your hillbilly friends to siege your opponents in a pickup truck dealing fire damage.

Pipebombs.desc: Throw a barrage of handcrafted pipe bombs dealing area of effect fire damage.

RogueChainsaw.desc: Throw a chainsaw on the ground spinning and dealing increased damage and additional arcane damage to monsters struck.

TireFire.desc: Throw a truck tire that deals fire damage on hit.

TreeTrunkTriumph.desc: Summon a massive tree and cut it down on nearby monsters dealing increased damage and additional arcane damage.

BattleGlance.desc: Perform an area of effect attack with increased damage and attack rating.

BladeBarrier.desc: Summon a barrier of rotating blades around you dealing Physical Damage and additional Arcane Damage.

EmpiresSlash.desc: Perform an area of effect attack blinking a short distance and dealing physical damage to monsters in its path. Empire slash lowers Omnislashes cooldown when it strikes a monster.

ExplodingBolas.desc: Throw bolas that deal arcane damage on impact and again when they explode after a short delay.

ExplosiveKunai.desc: Throw an explosive kunai that explodes and splits on impact, causing smaller explosions that deal Arcane damage.

Omnislash.desc: Become untargetable and rapidly strike monsters multiple times with increased attack rating dealing increased damage.

Quickslash.desc: Perform a quick dash unleashing area of effect slash dealing increased physical damage and knocking up monsters.

ShadowStep.desc: Step into the shadows, re-appearing at the target location dealing Arcane Damage to all nearby monsters.

ShurikenThrow.desc: Throw three piercing Shurikens at your target dealing increased damage.

SmokeBomb.desc: Explode a smoke bomb dealing arcane damage.

ChaosTotem.desc: Summon a totem that rapidly shoots chaos bolts dealing arcane damage.

EarthBind.desc: Raise vines from the ground dealing poison damage, poisoning and rooting monsters in place.

EarthTotem.desc: Summon a totem that fires rock fragments that deal area of effect arcane damage on hit.

FireTotem.desc: Spawn a totem that casts piercing fire projectiles dealing fire damage.

Fissures.desc: Rip the ground open with magic causing cracks that release fissures dealing arcane damage.

MeteorStorm.desc: Call down a meteor storm on target location dealing arcane damage.

RockFragments.desc: Unleash rock fragments towards target location dealing arcane damage.

SpiritWolves.desc: Spawn a spirit wolf to fight on your side.

StormTotem.desc: Summon a totem that releases chain lightning on nearby monsters dealing lightning damage.

TectonicBoulder.desc: Unleash a massive boulder that travels forward dealing arcane damage.

Tornado.desc: Summon a tornado traveling towards target direction dealing arcane damage to monsters on its path.

Twisters.desc: Unleash small twisters towards target location dealing arcane damage to monsters on their path.

BattleCharge.desc: Charge towards target location knocking monsters up and dealing arcane damage on impact.

Counter.desc: When active all monster attacks get countered with thrusting lances dealing arcane damage.

CrushingLance.desc: Call a crushing lance down from the sky smashing the target location dealing area of effect physical damage.

GloriousStrike.desc: Perform a powerful attack dealing physical area of effect damage.

HonedDefenses.desc: Every time you get hit by a monster attack gain stacks. At maximum stacks unleash a huge area of effect pulse dealing arcane damage to monsters around you. Can also be casted early to consume the stacks.

LanceThrust.desc: Perform a long ranged lance attack piercing monsters in a line dealing physical damage. If the lance comes in contact with a commending banner you get dragged to the banner smashing the ground stunning monsters on impact.

ShieldSlam.desc: Strike with your shield dealing physical damage based on the defense of your shield.

ShieldWall.desc: Cast a wall of shields around you blocking monster projectiles dealing arcane and physical damage on hit. Hitting an enemy with Shield Wall generates a Honed Defenses stack.

ApocalypticThunder.desc: Cast a high voltage thunder bolt on target spot stunning and dealing massive area of effect damage.

ChargedBolts.desc: Unleash multiple sparking bolts of electricity dealing lightning damage on hit.

LightningSurge.desc: Unleash a surge of lightning dealing lightning damage.

StaticShock.desc: Shock target location with static electricity inflicting monsters with static shock dealing lightning damage over time.

StormBolt.desc: Unleash a bolt of lightning dealing area of effect lightning damage.

StormCloud.desc: Conjure a storm cloud at target location striking monsters with surges of lightning dealing lightning damage.

Berserk.desc: Every successful hit with berserk increases your attack damage, attack speed and movement speed for berserk stacking up to 8 times.

Charge.desc: Charge forward dealing arcane damage and stunning monsters on impact.

OdinsFury.desc: Powerful warcry which deals arcane damage and stuns monsters around you.

SeismicSlam.desc: Smash monsters in front of you dealing damage and knocking them up and stunning them.

Shockwave.desc: Smash the ground causing a shockwave that deals area of effect damage and stuns monsters.

Throw.desc: When using any of the abilities, you have a chance to throw a piercing lance at a nearby monster dealing physical damage.

Whirlwind.desc: Spin your weapons around you dealing damage to monsters struck.

YmirsChampion.desc: Perform a cold enhanced strike with additive cold damage, Increased attack damage and attack rating. Attacks also freeze monsters and summons a spinning axe that deals additional damage.

Zeal.desc: Strike three fast and powerful attacks with increased attack rating.

BlackMass.desc: Summon all the coven's cultists to march in the name of satan inflicting arcane damage to monsters on their path.

BurstOfLight.desc: Cast a ray of divine light dealing arcane damage and lights monsters on heavenly fire.

ChainOfHolyLight.desc: Cast a holy lightning jumping from monster to monster dealing arcane damage.

DarkOath.desc: Conjure an aura that unleashes waves of unholy energy around you inflicting arcane damage to nearby monsters.

HeavenlyFire.desc: Light the target location into holy fire dealing arcane damage.

ManaOrb.desc: Summon a pulsating orb of mana that replenishes mana for players and deals arcane damage to monsters.

RestlessSpirits.desc: Unleash restless spirits from an unholy dimension to seek new hosts inflicting arcane damage to the target.

SatansMark.desc: Mark the monsters on target area for satan causing them to unleash pulses of arcane damage when struck by other abilities and attacks.

ShadowBolt.desc: Gather your inner darkness and unleash a powerful piercing shadow bolt that deals arcane damage to monsters on its path. The shadow bolt slows down after hitting a target.

SoulSpurn.desc: Rip the souls from nearest monsters dealing arcane damage and restoring your life and mana.
